key_findings: Bushen Huoxue Formula protected TNF-alpha-challenged nucleus pulposus cells by restoring autophagic flux and mitochondrial function via AMPK/SIRT1.
BSHXF reduced TNF-alpha-induced ECM degradation (MMP-3/9, ADAMTS-4/5) and apoptosis.
